Resource Gathering V1.01
by Roninator2
​
Introduction
A new approach to gathering / mining / fishing / etc...
Using this script you can configure a simple event script command to process a chance to gather resources.
Whether it be finding herbs, or using your pick axe to gather minerals or metals, all is adaptable.
Features
Place note tags on items with chance to obtain and player ability in that skill
Using Item note tags and actor Note tags with the event command, items can be gathered.
Uses the party leader for ability checks.
Members can be set to have higher limits than default.
Screenshots
none required
How to Use
Place below materials and above main.
Set note tags in the database. Items, Actors
Set script call on event.
Demo
none required. put script in and configure database, then use script call.
Instructions in script header.
